meta.description: Receives a validated lead from the funnel API, enforces idempotency on funnel_lead_id, upserts into Airtable, writes the qualification rows and logs the execution. Targets the live base described in docs/airtable-schema.md (autonumber lead_id, linked-record child tables).

nodes.name: Idempotency: Find Lead
nodes.notes: IDEMPOTENCY PROBE. Airtable has no unique constraints, so the check must be explicit and must run before any write. funnel_lead_id (the API's ld_ id) is the idempotency key; lead_id in this base is an autonumber.

nodes.name: Already Exists?
nodes.notes:
TRUE  -> duplicate: update in place, respond 200 duplicate=true.
FALSE -> new lead: create Leads + Qualification rows.

parameters.jsCode:
// Record id from the search result plus the fields a replay refreshes.
return [{ json: { id: $json.id, ...$('Verify & Validate').first().json.update_fields } }];

nodes.name: Update Existing Lead
nodes.notes: A replay carries the freshest data, so we update rather than ignore.

nodes.name: Log Duplicate Run
nodes.notes: Duplicates are recorded, not silently swallowed - 'duplicates prevented' is a real operational metric.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, duplicate: true, airtable_record_id: $('Update Existing Lead').first().json.id, workflow: 'lead_to_airtable' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Duplicate
nodes.notes: 200, NOT an error. A replay is an expected outcome of at-least-once delivery; returning an error here would make the caller's outbox retry forever.

nodes.name: Build Qualification Rows
nodes.notes: Runs before the run log (upper branch, executionOrder v1). If this branch fails the workflow errors, n8n returns 500 and the caller retries; idempotency makes that safe.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, duplicate: false, airtable_record_id: $('Create Lead').first().json.id, workflow: 'lead_to_airtable' }) }}

nodes.name: Respond Rejected
nodes.notes: 4xx is deliberate. The caller's outbox classifies 4xx as non-retryable and dead-letters immediately rather than burning its retry budget on a payload that can never be accepted.
